using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.Tests
{
    public class ReplicaSyncSessionTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task AcquireCheckpointEntryAsync_LogsInformationWithIteration()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var mockStoreWrapper = new StoreWrapper(); // Assuming default ctor or create a minimal stub
            var mockClusterProvider = new ClusterProvider(); // Assuming default ctor or create a minimal stub

            // Create instance of ReplicaSyncSession with logger injected
            var session = new ReplicaSyncSession(
                mockStoreWrapper,
                mockClusterProvider,
                logger: mockLogger.Object);

            // Act
            // Call AcquireCheckpointEntryAsync once to trigger the log on iteration 0
            await session.AcquireCheckpointEntryAsync();

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("AcquireCheckpointEntry iteration 0")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.AtLeastOnce);
        }
    }
}

using Moq;

{
    public class LoggerExtensionsTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void LogInformation_ExtensionMethod_CalledWithExpectedMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();

            // Act
            mockLogger.Object.LogInformation("AcquireCheckpointEntry iteration {iteration}", 0);

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("AcquireCheckpointEntry iteration 0")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, System.Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
